html:#Sec4.section_title: Genome-scale screen of QC collection identifies 68 genes not previously implicated in REE-bioleaching
facts: Mon2 consists of monazite-Nd and rhabdophane-Nd, in contrast to Mon1, which also contains neodymium oxyphosphate.
Gluconobacter oxydans B58-derived cultures produced biolixiviant for synthetic Mon2 phosphate feed, a monazite-Nd/rhabdophane-Nd mixture.
Post-contact leachates passed through 0.45 micrometre filters. Cell removal before mineral contact was not specified.
Diluted acidified filtrates were measured using an Agilent 7800 ICP-MS, with rare-earth calibration mix and rhodium internal standard (m/z 103).
Wild-type, proxy wild-type and no-bacteria controls were prepared; selected bacterial strains had three biological replicates.
Laboratory solubilization is the measured operation; no purified Nd recovery or industrial transfer is established.
